description: Estimates the naked-eye limiting magnitude at a city centre from the same ring-weighted Black Marble exposure that scores observing sites. Each curve point ties a statistic of the reviewed calibration-anchor distributions in data-config/scoring/darkness.json to the best-case limiting magnitude of a Bortle class. The result is an estimate, labelled as such on the page, and readers can always override it with their own setting.

curve.rationale: Typical reviewed dark-sky reference site: Bortle 1–3, shown at the 6.5 catalogue floor.
Typical reviewed rural site near towns (outskirts of Kanab, Mammoth Lakes, Queenstown): Bortle 5.
Brightest reviewed mid reference, on the edge of a city (Vienna Kahlenberg, Boulder Chautauqua): Bortle 6.
Darkest reviewed metropolitan centre still sits at the bright end of Bortle 7.
Every reviewed metropolitan centre (Berlin, London, Paris, Tokyo, New York …) is an inner-city sky; the lower quartile marks Bortle 8.
Upper quartile of reviewed metropolitan centres (New York, São Paulo, Cairo, Los Angeles, Dubai): Bortle 9.
